prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: annotated real build photograph for a student's Gridopoly README.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual photograph. Add only four English labels and thin leader lines pointing to the real parts. Preserve the actual photographic subject exactly: screen OFF, hand, wires, battery, PCB, USB port, green printed supports, lighting, perspective, textures and existing geometry. Do not invent, repaint, relocate, repair or simplify any hardware. This is a documentary annotation, not a product render.
Framing: make a compact landscape 4:3 detail by cropping empty wall above and floor below the assembly, retaining the complete display, green base, visible battery and PCB. Do not stretch the photo. Use available background for labels, leave the assembly unobscured.
Style: restrained technical callouts, clean bold sans-serif around 36–40 pixels on a 1200-pixel-wide image, near-black small rounded label panels with white type, fine cyan leader lines ending in small dots. No title, no branding, no extra text.
Text verbatim, each once:
"Round display" — leader endpoint on the dark circular glass face at the top.
"Power PCB" — endpoint on the thin horizontal circuit board at the level of the USB-C port, BETWEEN the upper and bottom green shelves; not on the green shelf.
"Battery" — endpoint on the silver/black pouch BELOW that PCB, LEFT of center.
"3D-printed stand" — endpoint on the green bottom plate near its left front edge.
Clearly separated lines. Check that the Battery and Power PCB labels point to DIFFERENT layers. Keep all labels and line endpoints inside the frame with comfortable margins. Preserve real photo detail and color, no stylization.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: annotated real build photograph for a student's Gridopoly README.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual photo of THREE black assembled circuit boards on a blue L-shaped printed support, held in a hand. Add only labels and leader lines. Preserve the actual photographic subject exactly, including the three PCB shapes, electronic components, headers, PCB printing, blue base, hand, lighting and camera perspective. No hardware re-rendering, invented boards, LEDs, text on PCBs, or cleaned-up circuitry.
Framing: compact landscape 4:3 photo detail by cropping excess empty wall above and floor below; retain all three boards, all connectors and the blue printed base. If needed allow a little surrounding background for callouts; do not stretch or alter the assembly.
Style: clean bold sans-serif, readable around 36–40 pixels at 1200 pixels wide. White text in restrained small near-black rounded panels, fine cyan leader lines ending in small dots. Match a real maker project, not a schematic. No title, logo, extra wording.
Exactly four English labels, each once:
"Long tile PCB" — point to the LEFT vertical rectangular PCB.
"Corner tile PCB" — point to the large upper-right square PCB, which has the black barrel power jack near its top edge.
"Module connectors" — point to the pair of joined black headers BETWEEN the upper-right corner PCB and the lower-right long PCB, not to the dangling bottom pins.
"3D-printed base" — point to a clearly visible BLUE support edge below the LEFT board.
Place text outside the circuit boards on surrounding background. Ensure leaders are unambiguous, avoid crossing them, and keep text inside the frame. Keep all three real boards intact. Annotation only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: annotated real photograph for the Gridopoly README.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. It shows an actual bright pink 3D-printed beaver game piece held by a hand, with a flat black RFID disk beneath the pink pedestal. Keep the real toy, exact figure design, facial expression, color, hand and finger shapes, pink base, black disk, lighting and perspective unchanged. Do not redesign or regenerate the figure, insert a different animal or turn the photo into an illustration.
Crop away empty wall and table to create a landscape 4:3 detail, retaining the whole figure, pink base, black tag and holding fingers. Only add TWO clear leader-line callouts, with no other text.
Text verbatim:
"3D-printed figure" — point to the pink beaver body ABOVE the pink base.
"RFID tag" — point specifically to the BLACK disk BELOW the pink base.
Use white bold sans-serif lettering on small near-black rounded panels, thin cyan lines ending in dots. Place both labels in open background to the left or right of the figure; never cover the figure. Readable at a 280px-wide README thumbnail. No invented electronics, exploded view, additional parts, logo, heading or decorative effects. Preserve original photography.
